description: The structured daily delivery for a machine-watched topic: up to 14 days of observed items (title, url, source, date) newest-first, plus the topic's live coverage-acceptance report, which grades the coverage and shows the evidence (it does not gate billing — billing starts when the Watch starts, and the month you are in is refundable in full, any time you ask, for any reason). Delivery is pull: poll daily or on demand. Topics not yet watched: get_quote prices them.

days.description: How many recent days to return (1-14, default 14)
